   "source": [
    "# 2. Per-event data: the geometry is never touched\n",
    "\n",
    "A chamber is static; an event is a table of numbers on its cells. The contract\n",
    "is one table keyed by `(sl, l, w)` plus the columns you want to colour by:\n",
    "\n",
    "```\n",
    "rows = [{\"sl\": 1, \"l\": 1, \"w\": 1, \"time\": 350}, ...]\n",
    "DTStationPatch(station, axis, vmap=\"time\", data=rows)\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "`vmap` names the column to map: it is `\"time\"` by default, and any column works.\n",
    "Because nothing is written on the geometry, the same `Station` object draws two\n",
    "events in a row."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "40061cc5",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:15.035345Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:15.034877Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.367728Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.365438Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "704 rows, 12 layers\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "[{'sl': 1, 'l': 1, 'w': 1, 'time': 337},\n",
       " {'sl': 1, 'l': 1, 'w': 2, 'time': 782},\n",
       " {'sl': 1, 'l': 1, 'w': 3, 'time': 264}]"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 1,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline\n",
    "import random\n",
    "\n",
    "from mpldts.geometry import Station\n",
    "from mpldts.geometry.sources import CMSXMLSource\n",
    "\n",
    "spec = CMSXMLSource().station(-2, 1, 2)\n",
    "station = Station.from_spec(spec, -2, 1, 2)\n",
    "\n",
    "def event(seed, low=200, high=900):\n",
    "    # one row per cell: a random drift time, as a digitised event would give\n",
    "    generator = random.Random(seed)\n",
    "    return [\n",
    "        {\"sl\": sl.number, \"l\": layer.number, \"w\": wid,\n",
    "         \"time\": generator.randint(low, high)}\n",
    "        for sl in spec.super_layers\n",
    "        for layer in sl.layers\n",
    "        for wid in layer.cells.ids()\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "first = event(1)\n",
    "print(len(first), \"rows,\", len({(r[\"sl\"], r[\"l\"]) for r in first}), \"layers\")\n",
    "first[:3]"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "20a825d0",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.372739Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.372100Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.771727Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.769757Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1300x400 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from mpldts.patches import DTStationPatch\n",
    "\n",
    "width, height, length = station.bounds\n",
    "x, y, z = station.local_center\n",
    "\n",
    "figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4))\n",
    "for axis, rows, title in zip(axes, (first, event(2)), (\"event 1\", \"event 2\")):\n",
    "    DTStationPatch(station, axis, faceview=\"phi\", local=True, vmap=\"time\", data=rows)\n",
    "    axis.set_xlim(x - width / 2 - 5, x + width / 2 + 5)\n",
    "    axis.set_ylim(z - height / 2 - 5, z + height / 2 + 5)\n",
    "    axis.set_title(title)\n",
    "    axis.set_xlabel(\"x [cm]\")\n",
    "    axis.set_ylabel(\"z [cm]\")\n",
    "figure.tight_layout()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1f118e49",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The station was built once and used twice. Its own values are unchanged, which\n",
    "is the point of the contract: geometry in, data on the side."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "4b2b8fa1",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.775352Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.774986Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.824549Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.822527Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "same centre: True\n",
      "cells in the view: 704\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "after = Station.from_spec(spec, -2, 1, 2)\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "print(\"same centre:\", bool(np.allclose(station.local_center, after.local_center)))\n",
    "print(\"cells in the view:\", sum(len(layer.cells) for sl in station.super_layers\n",
    "                               for layer in sl.layers))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "30d650ce",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## More than one column: `change_vmap`\n",
    "\n",
    "An event usually carries several quantities (`time`, `width`, a digitised\n",
    "charge...). `change_vmap` re-colours the same patch from the same rows."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "132a5b90",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.827049Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.826759Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:18.000726Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:17.998763Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "vmap: width | values: 704\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1300x400 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 4,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "patch = DTStationPatch(station, axes[0], faceview=\"phi\", local=True, vmap=\"time\",\n",
    "                       data=[dict(row, width=row[\"time\"] / 100.0) for row in first])\n",
    "patch.change_vmap(\"width\")\n",
    "print(\"vmap:\", patch.vmap, \"| values:\", len(patch.values))\n",
    "axes[0].set_title(\"event 1, coloured by width\")\n",
    "figure"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "89be6a60",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## A DataFrame from a ROOT ntuple or a CSV\n",
    "\n",
    "Anything with `to_dict` is accepted: a pandas DataFrame, one dict, or a list of\n",
    "dicts. The identifiers are cast to `int` for you, because a branch read from a\n",
    "ROOT file arrives as a float and `(1.0, 2.0, 3.0)` would never match a cell."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "81c65cd4",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:18.003979Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:18.003721Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:18.058315Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:18.055930Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "{'sl': 'float64', 'l': 'float64', 'w': 'float64'}\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "rows accepted: 704 | int cast: {'sl': 1, 'l': 1, 'w': 1, 'time': 337}\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "frame = pd.DataFrame(first)\n",
    "frame[[\"sl\", \"l\", \"w\"]] = frame[[\"sl\", \"l\", \"w\"]].astype(float)   # as ROOT gives them\n",
    "print({key: str(kind) for key, kind in frame.dtypes[[\"sl\", \"l\", \"w\"]].items()})\n",
    "\n",
    "patch = DTStationPatch(station, axes[1], faceview=\"phi\", local=True,\n",
    "                       vmap=\"time\", data=frame)\n",
    "print(\"rows accepted:\", len(patch.data), \"| int cast:\", patch.data[0])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7bd09ba0",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## The rules, in short\n",
    "\n",
    "- keyed by `(sl, l, w)`; the ids are integers and the patch casts them;\n",
    "- `vmap` selects the column, `time` by default;\n",
    "- a cell that is not in the table simply draws at 0;\n",
    "- nothing mutates the station: two events, one geometry.\n",
    "\n",
    "The next notebook writes a detector that is not in the CMS file at all."
   ]
  }
